# Qt add-on modules for every CI Qt install, by install profile. This is the only list:
# each install-qt-action step reads it through scripts/qt_modules.sh, and
# scripts/check_qt_module_lists.py refuses a hand-written `modules:` coming back.
#
# Profiles: app (every native app build), desktop (Linux/Windows/macOS on top of app),
# macos (macOS on top of desktop), wasm-host (host tools for the Wasm build), wasm (Wasm target).
#
# qttasktree is not used by Decenza. Qt's own CMake includes the config of every installed QML
# plugin, and QmlAssetDownloader (shipped with Qt QML) depends on Qt6TaskTree; without it every
# configure prints "Qt6QmlAssetDownloaderPrivate could not be found because dependency
# Qt6TaskTree could not be found". A local Qt install needs it for the same reason.
#
# module            profiles
qtquick3d           app wasm-host wasm
qtshadertools       app wasm-host wasm
qtgraphs            app wasm-host wasm
qtconnectivity      app
qtmultimedia        app
qtpositioning       app
qtspeech            app
qtwebsockets        app wasm
qtremoteobjects     app wasm-host
qtwebview           app
qtimageformats      app wasm
qtcanvaspainter     app wasm-host wasm
qttasktree          app
qtserialport        desktop
qtwebengine         macos
